title: Atlas import bundle (v1)
description: The import side of the portability surface: a batch of catalogue assets and manual relationships moved INTO Atlas. Unlike an export, assets may omit their Atlas 'id' (the runtime assigns one) and instead carry an importer-supplied 'externalId' used to resolve references and match on re-import. Catalogue data only — no paid-core analysis. See handbook 11 §2-3.

contractVersion.description: The atlas-contracts schema major version this bundle conforms to.

kind.description: Discriminates an import bundle from an export document.

mode.description: How the bundle applies to the existing catalogue. 'merge' upserts by identifier; 'replace' makes the target match the bundle. The runtime enforces the semantics; this only records intent.

ImportAsset.description: An asset to import. Must carry at least one of 'id' (an existing Atlas id) or 'externalId' (a source-system id), so it can be matched and referenced.

ImportRelationship.description: A manual relationship to import. Endpoints are references (asset 'id' or 'externalId' present in this bundle), resolved by the runtime and checked by the conformance kit.

type.description: The manual relationship vocabulary. Mirrors relationship.schema.json.
